attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no saint of this name on any day — a grep of every `saint.json` for «Υμέναι» and for Hymenaeus returns nothing — and the names the per-day sweep offered against it were Eumenius and Menas, which are other names and other men. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, no year, no place and no hymn.
